theme: A quiet day at home, Croatia on the horizon.
greeting: The girls are with you in St. Pete and the calendar is clear, Dan. The real pressure today is the Croatia list, which has to close from dry land before you fly on the 8th.

needsAttention.title: NACD New England call at noon tomorrow
needsAttention.detail: Larissa Ravetto hosts a Zoom intro with the NACD New England chapter (Ellen Richstone, Deb Rosenthal) at 12:00 PM Tuesday. Arrive with two or three thoughts on what you want from the chapter's board network.

needsAttention.title: Two Croatia lodging nights still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 19 Cavtat night after the charter and the Sept 20-22 St. Pete landing gap are both open p1s. Charter connectivity is poor, so both must be booked before you leave on the 8th.

needsAttention.title: Confirm checked bags on the Croatia ticket
needsAttention.detail: The issued Eurowings Discover ticket shows zero checked bags. Verify the allowance on the operating carrier's site and buy bags online now rather than at a European counter.

needsAttention.title: Build and pack the travel larder bin
needsAttention.detail: The one lidded tote that keeps your from-scratch cooking portable needs to be built before the Sept 3 house move, so the first migration is a test run while there is still time to fix it.

flagged.title: Warm intro from Brunswick's Josh Pasichow
flagged.detail: He connected you to Lauren Nadig at Brunswick and cc'd you; worth a short reply to Lauren.

flagged.title: Nautilus Sailing charter invoice unpaid
flagged.detail: A QuickBooks invoice for the Croatia charter shows a balance due and is not marked finished.

flagged.title: Morgan Stanley payment flagged for review
flagged.detail: An automated payment on your account was flagged for review; confirm you recognize it.

inbox.noise: The usual LinkedIn job alerts, a Care.com ping, and your daily Japanese lesson.
inbox.clear: Nothing else is awaiting your reply.

recipe.title: Green Salad with Green Beans
recipe.why: High summer means beans and tender leaves are at their peak, so keep it fresh and barely dressed.

tasks.title: Book refundable backup SUV rental, Sept 20-Oct 5
Buy Orlando / Disney park tickets for six
Call dermatologist to book wart removal
Buy EU plug adapters and a US power strip

acts.line: A clear morning at home in St. Pete with the girls and nothing on the calendar.
Still wide open, which is the natural window to close the Croatia bookings before they harden.
Pack the larder bin before Wednesday's move; tomorrow opens with the NACD New England call at noon.
